blockers.description: CI RED at daaf5fa: 2 failures in e2e/tasks-delete.e2e.spec.ts (04-20's spec). Both fail at line 112 — after seedTaskWithSubtasks() and signIn(), getByRole('button', {name: 'Fixture Deletable Task', exact: true}) is never visible (5s timeout, element not found). 46 of 48 e2e tests PASSED, so this is NOT a /admin/reset backend-wipe collision — it is a genuine defect in the one spec that was never executed.
blockers.workaround: None. Must be fixed before the phase can close. Likely causes to check in order: (1) the task card may not expose role=button with the title as accessible name — check how a passing spec locates a task card; (2) seedTaskWithSubtasks() may not attach the task to the board/column the test then opens; (3) the seed may succeed but the board page may need an explicit wait.

decisions.decision: Dropped per-wave CI blocking, then per-wave 3x test runs, at user request
decisions.rationale: Speed. Evidence supported the 3x drop (04-18 and 04-19 both 3/3 identical across six runs). The CI drop is what let daaf5fa's red e2e job go unnoticed until pause — visual and e2e are CI-only, since ignoreSnapshots:!CI makes local visual a no-op and local e2e wipes the shared backend.

Name another identifier in a comment only when load-bearing; naming an internal sibling for similarity ('mirroring X') is pure sync cost and is what rots. Measured: 717 identifier-naming comments, 331 distinct, 0 accidentally stale, both rot sites that day were sibling cross-references. Deliberately NOT mechanized — an 'identifier must resolve' gate would fire on all 18 dangling refs here, and all 18 are correct.

context_notes: Orchestrating /gsd-execute-phase 4 sequentially with ISOLATION=none (worktree base-check shouldDegrade=true; harness forks from origin/HEAD, #48). 20/22 plans have SUMMARYs; 04-21 is mid-plan and 04-22 remains. Working method that kept paying off: never trust an executor's green claim — re-run the gate from the orchestrator. It caught a red comments:check on the orchestrator's OWN comment, and a negative control proved 04-20's key-collision test genuinely fails without its fix (54 tests). The one thing that gate CANNOT catch is visual + e2e, which are CI-only — and that is precisely where daaf5fa went red.
